claims.claim_text: Officer(s): Officer D. Harmon, Corporal R. Fuentes
Witness(es): Female resident (W-1), reported domestic violence restraining order against subject

On January 16, 2023, at approximately 2136 hours, dispatch received a 9-1-1 call from a female resident (W-1) reporting that an unknown male was kicking her front door and demanding entry at her residence within the Old Ranch Condominium development in Seal Beach.
